title: He knocked on doors at 12, selling trash bags so he could buy basketball shoes.
caption:
He knocked on doors at 12, selling trash bags so he could buy basketball shoes.

He sold papers during a newspaper strike, taught disco in college and got fired from a software store for closing a sale.

Then: a $6M exit, a $5.7B Yahoo deal, a $40M jet bought online and an NBA title.

That kid is Mark Cuban. Forbes puts him at $6.8B.

Would you have bought a bag?
